rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the heavens or sky above.

example.english: I looked up at the sky and saw lots of stars.
example.traditional: 我頭先抬頭望個天，見到好多星。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tau4 sin1 toi4 tau4 mong6 go3 tin1 gin3 dou2 hou2 do1 sing1

rows.note: Use this for the visible appearance or condition of the sky at a particular time or place.

example.english: The sky is starting to get dark, so let’s go home quickly.
example.traditional: 天色開始暗喇，我哋快啲返屋企啦。
example.jyutping: tin1 sik1 hoi1 ci2 am3 laa3 ngo5 dei6 faai3 di1 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1

rows.note: Use this when the descriptive sky sense is really about the weather or atmospheric conditions.

example.english: The sky is so muggy today that I’m sweating all over.
example.traditional: 今日天氣咁焗，我成身都係汗。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 gam2 guk6 ngo5 seng4 san1 dou1 hai6 hon6
